biotools.summary: OpenMMDL is an open-source toolkit for preparing and simulating protein-ligand complexes in OpenMM, along with subsequent analysis of protein-ligand interactions. It provides a graphical user interface for setup, MD simulation capabilities, and analysis tools for ligand binding modes.
